**Architecture (zero third-party deps; AppKit + Carbon + CGEvent + Security + NaturalLanguage + URLSession):**

- TextCaptureService: pasteboard changeCount snapshot → CGEventPost ⌘C → bounded background poll (20ms, 1s cap) → trimmed text; emptySelection/timeout surfaced as Chinese panel messages
- LanguageRouter: NLLanguageRecognizer local pre-check (en/zh) → TranslationTask (sourceIsChinese drives prompt branch + panel layout)
- AIClient: POST {baseURL}/chat/completions (baseURL includes /v1 per mode.json format), non-streaming, 30s timeout, Codable models, error.message surfaced in Chinese; response_format=json_object with 400-fallback retry without it

Step 3 is a minimal-shell build milestone to de-risk conversion early. Xcode 26.1 + macosx26.1 SDK verified on machine; no shared scheme exists → xcodebuild auto-generates "jj-type" scheme.

**Top risks:** pbxproj hand-edit (mitigated: settings-only diff + early build milestone + git restore fallback), non-activating panel focus/Esc handling, response_format incompatibility (3-layer fallback), clipboard overwrite not restored (v1 decision, documented), ad-hoc signing fallback CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO if needed.

CODER Iteration 6 (status icon blocker) — ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED AND FIXED, awaiting user's manual confirmation (auto-launch command was rejected at execution, so I cannot spawn the app myself).

## Root cause (high confidence)
The built product Info.plist had NO `NSPrincipalClass`. On this macOS 26 beta / Xcode 26.1 combo, the AppKit `@main` bootstrap (NSApplicationMain path) instantiates the application object from NSPrincipalClass; without the key the delegate lifecycle never starts — which matches every symptom exactly: process alive idling, no crash, NO status item, and an EMPTY unified log (applicationDidFinishLaunching never ran, so nothing ever logged). Xcode storyboard templates never hit this because they inject NSPrincipalClass via plist generation; our custom-merged plist did not have it (GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE does not auto-add this key).

## Fixes applied (already built, Debug green)
1. Info.plist: added `NSPrincipalClass = NSApplication` — VERIFIED present in built product via PlistBuddy (`NSApplication`).
2. Bulletproof status icon: configureStatusIcon now (a) forces 18x18 size + scaleProportionallyDown when a symbol resolves, (b) falls back to visible title "文A" when symbol is nil OR zero-size — the icon can never be blank again.
3. Temporary os_log breadcrumbs at: didFinishLaunching ENTRY / statusItem created (button?image?title?frame) / symbol resolved (hasSymbol?size) / menu item count / hotkey conflict result / didFinishLaunching END (subsystem com.aigens.jj-type, category debug).

## What I need from the user (manual, 30 seconds)
Please launch like before (Xcode ⌘R or double-click the Debug app / re-run build-release.sh). Two outcomes:
- Icon appears → I remove breadcrumbs, rebuild Debug+Release, close Iteration 6.
- Icon still missing → tell me; I will read `log show --last 1m --predicate 'process == "jj-type"'` (read-only) and follow the trail — the breadcrumbs will now pinpoint whether didFinishLaunching runs and what the button contains.

Note: `log show` for process "jj-type" was empty before simply because the app had zero log statements AND (per root cause) the delegate never ran.

## TRUE root cause
`@main` on the NSApplicationDelegate is broken on this beta toolchain combo (delegate never constructed — app idles in the run loop). The fix replaces it with an explicit `jj-type/main.swift`: NSApplication.shared + AppDelegate() + delegate assignment + app.run() — bypasses the broken bootstrap entirely. Keep in mind for future: on this machine, AppKit menu-bar apps should use main.swift, not @main.

## B. Three user-feedback fixes
- B1 (only first recorder worked): root cause — plain NSViews never become first responder on click (unlike NSTextField), so keyDown only reached whichever view happened to hold focus. Fix: HotkeyRecorderView now does mouseDown → makeFirstResponder(self), acceptsFirstMouse, plus visible focus state (accent border on focus). Both recorders click-to-focus independently.
- B2 (cannot paste in settings fields): root cause — LSUIElement app has NO main menu, and AppKit text-editing key equivalents come from the main menu's Edit menu via the responder chain. Fix: installMainMenu() at launch builds an invisible main menu with a standard Edit submenu (undo/redo/cut/copy/paste/select-all, Chinese titles, standard key equivalents). ⌘V/⌘C/⌘X/⌘A/⌘Z now work in name/URL/key/model fields.
- B3 (auto-copy NEW): showResult now writes the corrected text (or translation when no correction) to the general pasteboard immediately; the 复制 button starts in 已复制 state (click re-copies + auto-dismisses); 替换原文 unchanged.

Uses CURRENT form values (unsaved OK); empty key field falls back to the saved Keychain key.

## 2. ⌥+D input-window mode — DONE
New TranslationWindowController (reused, 420×380 resizable, 「JJType 翻译」): multi-line input, 翻译/清空 buttons, spinner+status, selectable result area, auto-copy + 「已自动复制，可直接粘贴」. Enter→translate & Esc→close are handled by a content-view performKeyEquivalent override (NSTextView swallows plain Return, so the button equivalent alone would never fire). Flow: hotkey → capture fires FIRST (original app keeps focus so synthetic ⌘C lands correctly) while the window appears immediately via orderFrontWithoutActivating → capture success ⇒ prefill + auto-translate; no selection ⇒ NSApp.activate + empty focused input. ⌥+E flow untouched (capture → floating panel).

## 3. Missing second recorder — ROOT CAUSE FIXED (the It7 focus fix addressed a different real-but-secondary issue)
Root cause: the settings content view had a FIXED 520×560 frame with a bottom `lessThanOrEqual` constraint — on macOS 26, taller intrinsic control heights push the vertical stack's total past the frame, so trailing items (the SECOND HotkeyRecorderView + hint) were clipped below the window's bottom edge. That's exactly "user sees only the translate recorder". Fix: constraint-driven content view (TAMIC=false) + bottom EQUAL constraint → the window auto-sizes to the contentViewController fittingSize and can never clip, regardless of control heights or future rows. Focus fix from It7 (mouseDown→makeFirstResponder, acceptsFirstMouse, accent border) retained — it was necessary anyway.

## 1. Reasoning-model empty content — FIXED

## 2. Missing correct+translate recorder — ROOT CAUSE PROVEN VIA RUNTIME DUMP (three-strike honored: evidence before fix)
Dump method: temporary view-tree dump scheduled from init (windowDidLoad never fires for nib-less controllers) triggered via `open -n ... --args -openSettings -dumpSettings`.
EVIDENCE (before fix):
  recorder[translate] frame=(0, 38, 480, 220)   ← ballooned
  recorder[correct]   frame=(0, 26, 480, 0)     ← CRUSHED TO ZERO HEIGHT (invisible)
Diagnosis: HotkeyRecorderView is a plain NSView with NO intrinsic size — the vertical stack under the equal top/bottom constraints redistributed space arbitrarily: one recorder inflated, the other collapsed to 0. (It7 focus and It8 window-size were secondary/orthogonal.)
FIX: HotkeyRecorderView becomes a full auto-layout citizen — translatesAutoresizingMaskIntoConstraints=false + 28pt height constraint + required vertical hugging/compression. Plus window.setContentSize(fittingSize) after layout (constraints were added AFTER contentViewController assignment so the window had locked to the initial frame).
EVIDENCE (after fix):
  recorder[translate] frame=(0, 66, 407, 28)
  recorder[correct]   frame=(0, 26, 407, 28)   ← both 28pt, fully visible
Dump code + -openSettings trigger REMOVED (grep clean).

## 3. TranslationWindow UX — all four sub-items
a) defer-based single-exit loading reset in the translate Task (result/error/cancel/missing-key all covered).
b) Visible capture source: prefill count shown during loading (「已获取选中文本（N 字），正在翻译…」) and after success (「…· 已自动复制」); 清空 clears it; no-selection path force-clears input+result before focusing (no stale session text); the visible-N-char line is the mitigation for apps that ⌘C at cursor position (indistinguishable from real selection).
c) Status hints auto-fade after 3s (cancellable work item).
d) Click-outside closes: global+local mouseDown monitors, only when click is outside the window frame (never fights text editing); Esc kept; unified dismissWindow() installs/removes monitors.

## 1. Fade never clears — root-caused by code walkthrough (no instrumentation needed; cause was deterministic)
Root cause: the Task's `defer { setLoading(false) }` ran AFTER showResult, and the old setLoading(false) called cancelStatusFade() — cancelling the fade showResult had just scheduled → hint stuck forever. Fix: single status-write helper setStatus(_:color:fades:) (cancels prior fade, schedules 3s fade only for eligible texts); setLoading(false) now ONLY stops the spinner (deferred calls can no longer kill fades); dismiss/clear cancel.

## 2. Enter=translate — DONE via text-view subclass
TranslationInputTextView.keyDown: plain Return → translate, Shift+Return → newline (super). Note: plain Return (no ⌘) never reaches performKeyEquivalent at all — that's why the It8 content-view interception didn't cover the input field; keyDown is the reliable point.
